about: The one list of language libraries. packer/et/generate.py writes each app/<slug>/index.html, the sw.js cache list and VERSION, the vercel.json rewrites, the share-libraries.js routes, QR_LIBRARIES in packer/analytics.py and LIBRARIES in packer/library_mail.py from it. Edit this file, run npm run build, commit both. Field guide: docs/guides/adding-a-language.md.
